static_traits.name: Lin Beina
static_traits.social_status: More distant and irritable with colleagues than before; has a few friends to turn to, but has not yet discussed this specific problem with anyone
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness history; no similar psychological problems or treatment history before
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, steady pace, highly cooperative; able to identify and describe automatic thoughts; emotions mainly anxiety and worry

basic_info.main_problem: 'During a phone call, the business coach spoke to me very tersely, and I keep thinking he no longer wants to work with me; this thought makes me very anxious and tense.'
basic_info.core_demands: The persistent stress and anxiety triggered by this incident have affected work focus and overall physical and mental health; the client hopes for guidance and support.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough / not competent enough

special_situations.event: In a phone call with a business coach last week, the other's tone was brief and attitude appeared cold
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If he is cold toward me, it means I did something wrong or am not good enough; he may not want to work together anymore
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated self-reflection and review, avoiding direct communication for fear of seeming 'needy/unprofessional'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: He no longer wants to work with me; I must have done something wrong

special_situations.event: At moments when needing to interact with a business coach or make decisions for the online business
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I appear unsure or handle things poorly, he will look down on me and end the collaboration
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinating on decisions, repeatedly rehearsing conversations to lower the risk of being negated
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will mess up; he will end the collaboration

special_situations.event: Repeatedly recalls the details of that brief, abrupt phone call
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I say one wrong sentence on the call, it may cause the relationship to break down
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly replaying in the mind, morally blaming oneself in hopes of 'correcting mistakes'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all my fault; he is impatient with me because I am not good enough

special_situations.event: Feeling the increased pressure of making the online business succeed
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the business does not succeed, it proves I am incompetent; once the coach stops supporting me, my career will collapse
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Excessively attends to negative cues, frequently seeks reassurance and external cues to assess risk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If this collaboration goes wrong, my career is over

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and supported by professional others (such as a coach), maintaining a stable cooperative relationship
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being rejected, negated, or seen as unprofessional, thus losing important relationships and opportunities
defense_goal: Lowering the risk of being rejected through self-blame and avoiding direct clarification
Maintains surface harmony to preserve a fragile sense of safety

object_relations.object_representation: A judging/controlling figure who may deny and reject at any time

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to communicate directly with the coach and clarify the other's attitude or intention
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: If I voice my worries, I will seem needy and unprofessional, thus being looked down on or rejected
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cautious tone, emphasizes professional image and risk concerns, proposes various possible negative consequences to postpone or avoid direct communication

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing the emotional impact of that brief phone call
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Directly touching the feelings of being rejected would make me lose control; rational analysis is safer
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Inclined to analyze 'causes and possibilities', describes events in objective wording, reducing emotional vocabulary and emotional expression

manifestations: Worrying that the coach ending the collaboration will rupture the relationship and isolate one professionally
More distant from colleagues, irritable, reduced emotional connection
Hesitates to express genuine concerns to avoid seeming 'needy'
Bearing choice and responsibility for online business success, causing intense pressure
Anxiety rising at critical decision moments, tending to procrastinate and ruminate

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Worrying that expressing worries will seem needy or unprofessional
Emphasizes controlling her image when speaking to avoid being looked down on

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Projecting one's self-doubt and unease as 'the other person is fed up with me and wants to end the collaboration'
Still infers others' negative intentions when lacking evidence

positive_force: Good past collaboration with the coach, who is usually open and supportive
Able to identify and describe automatic thoughts, willing to do reality testing and restructuring
Has some social support (several friends to turn to for help)
negative_force: Cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, mind reading, and personalization are marked
High pressure and high standards about the online business's success intensify anxiety
Avoiding direct clarification to dodge the risk of being rejected, leaving misunderstandings unresolved
Anxiety impairs sleep and appetite, decreased work focus

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent excessive worry and repeated thinking around the relationship with the business coach
antecedent: Thinking about interactions with the coach
Making key decisions related to the online business
target_behavior.core_reason: Worries about being rejected/negated and the belief 'I am not good enough'
target_behavior.function: Gaining a temporary sense of control and safety through repeated thinking, avoiding uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety intensified,Sleep and appetite affected,Decreased work focus

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids communicating sensitive concerns directly with the coach
antecedent: Plans to express concerns about that phone call to the coach
Feeling nervous before an upcoming interaction
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of being seen as needy or unprofessional, thus being rejected
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential rejection and embarrassment, temporarily easing anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: Misunderstandings are hard to clarify in time; negative assumptions persist and expand

target_behavior.behavior: Showing withdrawal and irritability toward colleagues at work
antecedent: Thinking of the incident with the coach
target_behavior.core_reason: Accumulated anxiety and unexpressed emotions turning outward into defensive reactions
target_behavior.function: Briefly releasing tension, reducing the socializing load
target_behavior.consequence: Damaged interpersonal relationships, less use of the support system, further worsening the sense of isolation and anxiety
